simple.meaning: מְרוֹחַ (mᵉrôwach) is a Hebrew word meaning “bruised , i.e. emasculated.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְרוֹחַ (H4790) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְרוֹחַ (H4790) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְרוֹחַ (mᵉrôwach) / H4790 is traced through Leviticus 21:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4790. meroach [ מָרוֺחַ ] noun [masculine] dubious, only construct אָ֑שֶׁךְ מְרוֺחַ Lev 21:20 ; v either מָרַח rub = a rubbing away of the testicle ; or רָוַח be roomy, enlarged = enlargement (read then מֶרְוַח ); see further Di. מָרוֺם see רום .

occurrences.englishText: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.
